item.title: Leaf Reader 1.5.9
item.description:
• Linked read-aloud progress with saved AI source anchors, so the expanded AI panel scrolls to related analysis while playback advances.
  • Synced read-aloud progress with AI translation and linked word bubbles across PDF, EPUB, DOCX, and web-backed reading views.
  • Improved source matching for repeated or partial passages by combining source keys, word IDs, page bounds, and reading progress.
  • Split the read-aloud AI tracking logic into a focused module for easier TTS and AI panel maintenance.
